title: Fieldnote / product concept
purpose: Present a fictional offline research tool concept

slides.headline:
Capture the field.
Keep the context.
slides.message: Fieldnote is a concept for organizing research observations when connectivity is unreliable.
slides.source: Original concept scenario, not a real product, customer result, benchmark or release announcement.

slides.headline: Design around the research session.
slides.message: The proposed workflow keeps the observation and its context together.
slides.source: Original concept scenario, not a real product, customer result, benchmark or release announcement.

slides.headline: Offline-first is a product decision.
slides.message: The architecture must make state and uncertainty visible to the researcher.
slides.source: Original concept scenario, not a real product, customer result, benchmark or release announcement.

columns.title: During collection
columns.body: Show local save state. Avoid suggesting that an unsynced note is backed up remotely.

columns.title: During reconciliation
columns.body: Expose conflicts. Let the researcher resolve meaning rather than silently replacing text.

slides.headline:
Trust is a visible
system state.
slides.message: A save indicator should communicate what has actually happened, not merely that a button was pressed.
slides.source: Original concept scenario, not a real product, customer result, benchmark or release announcement.

slides.headline:
Validate the workflow
before the feature list.
slides.message: Next research: observe a field session, prototype interruptions and test recovery with participants.
slides.source: Original concept scenario, not a real product, customer result, benchmark or release announcement.
